svg.title: A mixture-of-experts router picking experts for each token, layer by layer
svg.text: How a Mixture-of-Experts Model Routes Each Token
IBM Granite 3.0 1B-A400M has 32 experts in each of its 24 layers, and its router sends every token to 8 of them. This is a real forward pass over one sentence.
goes to, stronger for more weight
do the work for any one token.
29.3 of the 32 in a layer on average.
